## The restart from the chain record, by link (Bare-0, a forced resume)

The boot path is bootsm.py. The live frame adds the resume exchange of RG-19.

| link | rear glance | safe screen | session offered | live frame p50 | live frame p99 | full session p50 | frames not live |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wi-Fi, a known dock | 25 ms | 46 ms | 192 ms | 293 ms | 308 ms | 357 ms | 60 |
| 5G, modem attached in idle | 25 ms | 276 ms | 373 ms | 478 ms | 677 ms | 547 ms | 49 |
| 5G, modem cold (the default) | 25 ms | 276 ms | 2.31 s | 2.42 s | 2.62 s | 2.49 s | 515 |
| 5G loaded cell, modem cold | 25 ms | 376 ms | 2.41 s | 2.53 s | 2.81 s | 2.60 s | 517 |

The price of an attached modem in SUSPENDED: the draw rises from 25 mW to 55 mW. The guaranteed SUSPENDED life falls from 72 to 33 min.
